newsitem.title: USA: Motorola makes regional management changes.
newsitem.headline: Motorola makes regional management changes.

text.p: Motorola Inc said Friday it made changes in its regional management and named a new president of its Land Mobile Products Sector (LMPS).

Merle Gilmore, formerly president and general manager of Motorola's LMPS, was appointed president of Europe, Middle East and Africa Region. He succeeds James Norling, who recently became president and general manager of the Messaging, Information and Media Sector.
Robert Barnett, formerly senior vice president and general manager of the iDEN Group of LMPS, succeeds Gilmore as president of the sector.
Keith Bane, executive vice president and chief corporate staff officer, was appointed president of the Americas Region, a new position that includes Canada, Latin America and the United States.
Motorola provides wireless communications, semiconductors, and advanced electronic systems, components, and services.
